Name: Praveen Kumar
Bio: Prof Praveen Kumar is an Associate Professor at Plaksha University. He previously held an Associate Professor position at the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science, Kolkata, and completed postdoctoral research as a Marie Curie Fellow at Universidad Politécnica de Madrid and as a Postdoctoral Fellow at Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research. He holds a PhD in Physics from IIT Delhi and an MSc in Physics from the University of Rajasthan.
Education: PhD, IIT Delhi | MSc, Physics, University of Rajasthan
Research_Summary:
Prof Kumar's current research develops advanced materials and quantum optoelectronic devices for energy harvesting and conversion. His thrust includes single-photon emitters and single-photon avalanche detectors designed to operate in the visible spectrum at room temperature.

Areas of work:

Quantum materials and devices

Two-dimensional materials, including TMDCs, MXenes, h-BN, and oxides

Self-powered and broadband photodetectors

Spin-manipulated hydrogen generation
